newsitem.title: USA: First Midwest Financial to repurchase shrs.
newsitem.headline: First Midwest Financial to repurchase shrs.

text.p: First Midwest Financial Inc said Wednesday it plans to repurchase five percent of its 2,733,940 outstanding shares over the next 12 months.

The shares will be purchased at prevailing market prices from time to time during the 12-month period, depending upon market conditions, in the open market and in private transactions, the company said.
The company also said it completed the repurchase of 220,883 shares, or about 7.5 percent of its outstanding shares of common stock at prices between $15.50 and $17.25 a share.
First Midwest shares were down 1/8 at 15-1/4 wednesday.
